title: Quasi-Polynomial Budget Bound
statement: For every natural number $n$, let $B(n)=2^{(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor)^2+1}$, where the exponent uses the natural-number base-$2$ logarithm. Then $B(n)+1\le 3n^{\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor}$.
